intro: We run SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO) for established Los Angeles companies. That means technical fixes, local search across the county's many cities, content that answers real questions, and the outside mentions that make your business show up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers, reported monthly in plain numbers.

sections.h: Why ranking in LA is harder than it looks
p: Los Angeles is not one search market. The county has 88 incorporated cities, from Santa Monica and Pasadena to Long Beach, Glendale and Burbank, plus well-known neighborhoods inside the city of LA itself. Someone looking for a dentist types "Silver Lake dentist" or "dentist in Torrance", not "LA dentist", and Google answers with businesses close to where they are standing. Matching those searches, place by place, is the daily work of local SEO. Los Angeles traffic adds a twist: a business twenty miles away can feel like it is in another city, so proximity weighs heavily.

On top of that, the categories with the most money in them (personal injury law, med spas, cosmetic dentistry, real estate) are some of the most crowded online anywhere in the US. That is why a generic plan rarely works in SEO. Los Angeles businesses in those categories need a plan built around specific places, specific questions and the trust signals that set them apart.

sections.h: How generative engine optimization fits in
p: More buyers now ask an AI assistant before they search. "Best Pasadena estate planning lawyer" or "which Santa Monica med spa is good for laser treatments" gets a short answer that names a few businesses. We check what those assistants currently say about you and your competitors, then work on the sources they draw on: clear pages on your site, accurate profiles, reviews, and mentions in trusted publications and lists.

This sits on top of good SEO rather than replacing it. Pages that rank well and answer questions directly tend to be the ones AI answers draw on. For a US aesthetics practice we ran a 35-question search audit across five AI engines, mapping where the practice appeared, where competitors did instead, and what to fix first.

sections.h: Doing local SEO for Los Angeles from London
p: Local SEO does not require us to be in your building. It requires knowing your locations, your service areas and your customers, which we learn on calls in your morning (London is 8 hours ahead of Pacific time most of the year). The rest happens in your website, your Google Business Profile and the wider web.

One honest note: because we have no office in Los Angeles, our own business does not compete in the LA map pack. Your business does, from your real address, and that is what we optimize. If an in-person content or photo day at your location would help, we plan it when the project needs it.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take to work in Los Angeles?
faqs.a: Technical fixes and Google Business Profile improvements tend to show first. Ranking for competitive LA searches takes steady work, and longer in categories like personal injury or med spas. We report monthly on leads and rankings, so you can see the direction early rather than waiting for a big reveal.

faqs.q: Can you help us rank in different LA neighborhoods and cities?
faqs.a: Yes, within limits Google respects. Your Google Business Profile ranks from your real address, so map results stay strongest near your locations. For other areas you serve, we build genuinely useful pages for those places, with local details and proof, rather than thin pages with the city name swapped in.

faqs.q: How much do reviews matter for local SEO in Los Angeles?
faqs.a: A lot. Review count, recency and the words customers use all feed into map rankings and into how AI assistants describe you. We set up a simple, policy-compliant way to ask happy customers for reviews and to reply to every review, good or bad. It is one of the quickest wins in SEO. Los Angeles clinics and law firms in particular often have strong service but few recent reviews.

faqs.q: What is GEO and does my business need it?
faqs.a: Generative engine optimization is the work of making sure AI assistants describe your business accurately and include it in their answers. If your buyers research with ChatGPT, Gemini or Google AI Overviews before calling, it matters. It builds on SEO: clear answers on your site, consistent profiles and mentions in trusted sources.

faqs.q: Do you do SEO for Los Angeles personal injury law firms?
faqs.a: Yes. Writing monthly SEO content for US personal injury firms is a core part of our work, and every legal statement and statute is checked before it goes live. For California firms that includes deadlines, comparative fault rules and the details of how claims work in local courts. Your attorneys review content before publishing.

faqs.q: Do you offer SEO in Spanish for LA businesses?
faqs.a: Yes. Many Los Angeles customers search in Spanish, especially for legal, medical and home services. We plan Spanish pages around how people actually search, set up language tags properly and recommend native-speaker review, rather than machine-translating the English site.

faqs.q: Will you meet us in Los Angeles?
faqs.a: We work remotely from London with calls in your morning Pacific time, which suits SEO well because the work happens online. If a content workshop or photo day at your location would help, we plan a visit when the project needs it.
